name: product-intel-monorepo
description: Monorepo containing AI-powered Business Analytics Assistant frontend and backend.

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.train: cd backend && uv run python src/pipeline/trainer.py
